snippet.title: Ember and Blade - Early Access Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Early access opens January 8th 2027! You play an immortal demon hunter facing the archdemon Asmodeus in this Survivors-like, with bullet-hell hordes, Souls-like bosses, and angelic blessings that change your powers every run. From LINE Games.
